t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. The itelareme, ingarte atyenhe, unte yenge mpwareke thengenhe worshipemiletyenenge. He testifyirreme, lyete nhenhe, yenge weak, unte rlterrke nthurre. Yenge arrangkwe aneme, unte akngerre nthurre akerte.
